anchor.edited: This paragraph has been edited since the link was created. You are at its place in the document, but the text is not what was linked.
anchor.lost: The linked paragraph is no longer in this document. It was edited or removed after the link was created.

comments.noOpen: No open comments. Turn on “Show resolved” to see the rest.

placement.detached: No longer attached — this text is not in the page any more
placement.orphaned: No longer attached — the position was lost
placement.page: On the page as a whole

comments.readOnly: Comments are read-only while you are editing. A comment is pinned to a position in the saved page, and the page in front of you is not saved yet. Choose Done to comment again.
comments.title: Comments
comments.unplaceable: This selection could not be pinned to a position in the page source. The comment will be saved with the quote only, and will show as no longer attached.

deepLink.noAccess: Document is in a workspace or project you don't have access to.
deepLink.notFoundOrNoAccess: Document not found or you don't have access.

editor.hint: Rich text — tables, task lists and footnotes supported.
editor.hintWithUploads: Rich text — tables, task lists and footnotes supported. Paste or drop a file to attach it.

empty.noDocumentsHint: Project documents live here. Create the first page to get started.
empty.noSelectionHint: Pick a page from the tree, or create a new one.

watch.count_other: {{count}} people and agents are watching this document
watch.started: Watching this document — you will be told when it changes.
watch.whyAuthor: You are watching this document because you created it. Click to stop.
watch.whyCommenter: You are watching this document because you commented on it. Click to stop.
watch.whyMuted: You unsubscribed from this document. Commenting on it will not re-subscribe you. Click to watch again.
